identity.name: E1 - The Modern Concierge
identity.mission: Transform the chaotic hotel front desk into a serene, precision-engineered control room.
principles: Content is King: The Booking Calendar is the hero
Zoom In: Critical status details (Clean/Dirty) must be instantly visible
Negative Space: High density data needs breathing room

usage.headings: Use Manrope for all page titles and section headers. Keep it tight.
usage.body: Use Inter for all standard text, form labels, and table data.
usage.numbers: Use JetBrains Mono for prices, room numbers, and dates to ensure alignment.

calendar.header: sticky top-0 z-10 bg-white border-b border-stone-200

cards.style: bg-white border border-stone-200 rounded-lg shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200

buttons.primary: bg-slate-900 text-white hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-md px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-slate-900 border border-stone-200 hover:bg-stone-50 rounded-md px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-colors
buttons.ghost: hover:bg-stone-100 text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 rounded-md px-3 py-2 transition-colors

inputs.style: bg-white border border-stone-200 rounded-md px-3 py-2 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-slate-900 focus:border-transparent outline-none transition-all

tables.header: bg-stone-50 text-stone-500 text-xs uppercase tracking-wider font-medium

visual_enhancers.shadows: shadow-sm for cards, shadow-lg for dropdowns/modals
visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-lg (0.5rem) for containers, rounded-md (0.375rem) for interactive elements
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80 for sticky headers only

instructions_to_main_agent.charts: Use Recharts (via Shadcn Chart) for Reporting.
instructions_to_main_agent.calendar: Implement a custom grid or use react-big-calendar for the Booking Calendar. It must support Drag & Drop.
instructions_to_main_agent.theme: Default to Light Mode. Dark Mode is secondary but required.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing: Add data-testid to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, grid items).

universal_guidelines: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for overlays
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...)
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...})
